    <script>
      const F = (f) => f / 30; // timings authored on a 30fps beat grid
      const TOTAL = __TOTAL__;
      const WORDS = __WORDS__;
      const PAGES = __PAGES__;
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      /* ---------- camera: punch-ins + shake ---------- */
      const ZOOMS = [[26, 1.1], [72, 1.04], [121, 1.0], [178, 1.08], [302, 1.12], [340, 1.02], [399, 1.08], [477, 1.12]];
      const drift = (f) => 1 + (f / (TOTAL * 30)) * 0.03;
      tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1.06 * 1.1 }, { scale: 1.06, duration: 0.55, ease: "power3.out" }, 0);
      ZOOMS.forEach(([f, s]) => tl.to("#cam", { scale: s * drift(f), duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.4)" }, F(f)));
      [[8, 9], [43, 9], [73, 9], [104, 16]].forEach(([f, a]) =>
        tl.to("#shake", { keyframes: [{ x: a, y: -a * 0.7 }, { x: -a * 0.7, y: a * 0.5 }, { x: a * 0.4, y: -a * 0.3 }, { x: 0, y: 0 }], duration: 0.27, ease: "none" }, F(f)),
      );

      /* ---------- hook ---------- */
      const price = (id, inAt, strikeAt, parkAt, parkX) => {
        tl.fromTo(`#p${id}`, { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50, scale: 2.4, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(2)" }, F(inAt));
        tl.fromTo(`#s${id}`, { scaleX: 0, rotation: -9 }, { scaleX: 1, rotation: -9, duration: F(5), ease: "power3.out" }, F(strikeAt));
        if (parkAt) tl.to(`#p${id}`, { x: parkX - 540, y: -132, scale: 0.38, opacity: 0.75, color: "#d9e4ea", duration: 0.4, ease: "power3.out" }, F(parkAt));
      };
      tl.set(["#p400", "#p300", "#p200", "#stamp-in"], { opacity: 0 }, 0);
      price("400", 6, 20, 40, 390);
      price("300", 41, 60, 72, 690);
      price("200", 72, 96, null, 0);
      tl.fromTo("#stamp-in", { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50, rotation: -7, scale: 3, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(2.5)" }, F(103));
      tl.to("#hook-in", { opacity: 0, y: -120, filter: "blur(12px)", duration: F(7), ease: "power2.in" }, F(114));

      /* ---------- product title ---------- */
      const T0 = F(121);
      tl.fromTo("#t-kicker", { opacity: 0, scale: 1.25 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.66, ease: "power3.out" }, T0);
      tl.fromTo(".t-ch", { opacity: 0, y: 50, scale: 1.4, filter: "blur(14px) drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(47,184,255,0.55))" },
        { opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1, filter: "blur(0px) drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(47,184,255,0.55))", duration: F(10), stagger: F(1.6), ease: "power3.out" }, T0 + F(4));
      tl.fromTo("#t-by", { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2)" }, F(167));
      tl.to("#title-in", { opacity: 0, scale: 1.25, duration: F(7), ease: "power2.in" }, F(177));

      /* ---------- captions (word by word) ---------- */
      PAGES.forEach(([a, b], i) => {
        const start = F(WORDS[a].s - 2);
        tl.fromTo(`#cap${i}`, { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, y: 20 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: "back.out(2)" }, start);
        for (let k = a; k <= b; k++) {
          const el = `#w${k}`;
          const at = F(WORDS[k].s - 2);
          tl.fromTo(el, { scale: 0.96, color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)" }, { scale: 1.12, color: document.querySelector(el).dataset.hl, duration: 0.05, ease: "none" }, at);
          tl.to(el, { scale: 1, duration: 0.2, ease: "power2.out" }, at + 0.05);
        }
      });

      /* ---------- promo stickers ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#basket-in", { x: -200, scale: 0.4, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, F(228));
      tl.to("#basket-in", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.2 }, F(292));
      tl.fromTo("#promo-in", { x: 300, scale: 0.4, rotation: 0, opacity: 0 }, { x: 0, scale: 1, rotation: -3, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, F(264));
      tl.to("#promo-in", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.2 }, F(292));
      tl.fromTo("#checkout-in", { xPercent: -50, scale: 0, opacity: 0 }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, F(301));
      tl.to("#checkout-in", { keyframes: [{ scale: 0.9, duration: 0.1 }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.13 }] }, F(309));
      tl.fromTo("#ripple", { scale: 0, opacity: 1 }, { scale: 2.2, opacity: 0, duration: F(16), ease: "power2.out" }, F(310));
      tl.fromTo("#co-tick", { strokeDashoffset: 24 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: F(8), ease: "power2.out" }, F(316));
      tl.to("#checkout-in", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.8, duration: 0.2 }, F(336));

      /* ---------- scent chips ---------- */
      [[1, 399], [2, 430], [3, 447]].forEach(([n, f]) => {
        tl.fromTo(`#chip${n}`, { y: 60, scale: 0.5, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2)" }, F(f));
        tl.fromTo(`#tick${n}`, { strokeDashoffset: 24 }, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: F(7), ease: "power2.out" }, F(f + 2));
      });
      tl.to(".chip", { opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, duration: 0.2 }, F(468));

      /* ---------- CTA: one clean fade/slide ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#cta-in", { y: 24, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: F(10), ease: "power3.out" }, F(477));

      /* ---------- look / transitions ---------- */
      tl.fromTo("#frost-fill", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: F(7) }, F(119));
      tl.to("#frost-fill", { opacity: 0, duration: F(12) }, F(172));
      tl.fromTo("#dust", { opacity: 0.35 }, { opacity: 1, duration: F(9) }, F(119));
      tl.to("#dust", { opacity: 0.35, duration: F(22) }, F(178));
      document.querySelectorAll(".mote").forEach((m) => {
        const y0 = +m.dataset.y, sp = +m.dataset.sp;
        tl.fromTo(m, { y: y0 }, { y: y0 - sp * 30 * TOTAL, duration: TOTAL, ease: "none",
          modifiers: { y: (v) => (((parseFloat(v) % 2000) + 2000) % 2000) - 40 + "px" } }, 0);
      });
      [["#fl0", 0, 0.9, 7], ["#fl1", 26, 0.35, 4], ["#fl2", 121, 0.95, 10], ["#fl3", 178, 0.35, 4], ["#fl4", 340, 0.35, 4]].forEach(([el, f, s, len]) => {
        tl.fromTo(el, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: s, duration: F(1), ease: "none" }, Math.max(0, F(f) - 0.001));
        tl.to(el, { opacity: 0, duration: F(len - 1), ease: "power1.out" }, F(f + 1));
      });

      tl.set({}, {}, TOTAL);
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
